attempts.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across node1 (primary), node2 and node3 (async read-only standbys) on AlmaLinux 9. Verified writes on the primary propagate to both standbys and that standbys reject writes. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes (standbys first, primary last), proving changed boot IDs and confirming full recovery of PostgreSQL, replication streaming, and data on each.
